en.title: B
en.summary: The letter B is a consonant in the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: Sound of letter B
paragraphs: The name of this letter is /b/. It always makes the sound /b/, as in the word (băiat) /bun/, which means good. This letter has only one sound in Romanian. It never changes its value across different words or positions.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Close both lips firmly to stop the flow of air. Let your vocal cords vibrate to produce voice. Then open your lips quickly so the trapped air bursts out. Put your hand on your throat. You can feel a steady vibration as the sound breaks out.

sections.title: Reading and spelling
paragraphs: This letter always keeps the sound /b/ in all standard positions. You hear it at the start of a word, as in (bun) /bun/. You also hear it clearly at the end of a word, as in (alb) /alb/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: There is no real pitfall with this letter. It sounds just like the letter b in the ordinary English word book. Always remember to use your voice fully, even when the letter comes at the end of a word.
